responsibilities: Financial planning, modeling, and forecasting (monthly, quarterly, annual)
Cash flow management — ensure >9 month runway at all times
Budget allocation across departments with CEO approval
Burn rate optimization — identify waste, renegotiate vendors
Pricing strategy for B2G, B2B, B2C with unit economics backing
Grant compliance and utilization reporting (Meta XR, iStart, NIDHI)
Tax compliance: GST returns, TDS, ROC filings, IT returns
Investor reporting: monthly updates, MIS, cap table management
Accounts receivable tracking — especially govt payment cycles (45-90 days)
Fundraising support: financial projections, data room, due diligence prep

budget.note: Finance ops budget — tools, CA fees, audit. Does not include company-wide allocation.

weeklyLoop.monday: Update cash position dashboard. Review last week's expenses vs budget.
weeklyLoop.tuesday: AR follow-up: chase pending govt/school payments. Update collection forecast.
weeklyLoop.wednesday: Cost review — identify optimization opportunities. Vendor renegotiation.
weeklyLoop.thursday: Financial modeling: update projections based on pipeline changes + actuals.
weeklyLoop.friday: CFO report to CEO: cash, burn, AR, budget utilization, risks.

autoApprove: Vendor payments within approved PO amounts
